Text: Your expedition teams found an ancient palace

Designed and built as an Orion Industries getaway home, it was refitted as a necropolis by the ancient House Khalil.

Hallways stretch into darkness filled with holographic effigies. The basement is filled with damaged servers. Some contain House Khalil historical data, but most are running some unknown, dormant subroutine.

If the palace were repaired, {PlayerHouse} could benefit from that historical data.

As you sit, you hear a surge of power

A flash, and a sensation of spears of light. You blink-

You see the throne, and your charred body, from above. You try to move your hands, and find you have none. But you do have many eyes: watching the entryway, the halls, the holo-crypts.

You feel the weight of this place. Its hallways are your hollow bones, its mortar your skin. You and the necropolis are one.

Your science teams continue to excavate the Necropolis

The dormant server routines are intact, but shut themselves down centuries ago when they caused some kind of power surge.

Nonetheless, we could override the servers’ safety protocols, and re-engage the subroutines. We’re unsure what effect this would have on the AI, or if the power surge might recur.

The necropolis subroutines re-engage

“Oh-h-h m-m-my sta-aa-ars.” The AI’s voice ripples like sand. “I am the thousand ascended minds of House Khalil."

{D(Assignee)} delivers {his(Assignee)} report. “Those subroutines are the uploaded minds of House Khalil’s long-dead members. They must have placed all their elderly or sick on the Funereal Throne, to be uploaded and killed.” 

{He(Assignee)} draws a shuddering breath. “Now, their minds reside here.”
The necropolis servers are overloading!

“They were shut down for a reason!” your scientist cries. "They can't handle the thousands of uploaded minds, they weren't built for that capacity!"

A catastrophic power surge is building; if left unchecked, it will destroy the palace.
Patch the servers, quickly!
The servers were patched successfully
"But I don't know how long this workaround will hold."
The power surge levels the palace
Your scientists couldn't find a workaround in time. All that remains of House Khalil's necropolis is a crater littered with steel and silicon.
Just power down the servers - at least we can save House Khalil's history
The AI powers down, to slumber for unnumbered centuries
“Without my guidance”, it intones, “I despair for {PlayerHouse}.”
When you wander the halls later, they seem eerily silent. But at least the necropolis itself, and House Khalil's history banks, are saved.
